scripts.native:dev: npm run version:sync && set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && tauri dev
scripts.native:check: npm run version:sync && set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.native:build: npm run version:sync && set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && tauri build
scripts.native:test: npm run version:sync && set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.native:clippy: npm run version:sync && set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%" && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --check app.js && node --check finance-core.js && node --check state-core.js && node --check ui-core.js && node --check cards-core.js && node --check cards-ui.js && node --check planned-core.js && node --check planned-ui.js && node --check projection-ui.js && node --check home-ui.js && node --check movements-ui.js
scripts.verify: npm run version:sync && npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run native:fmt && npm run native:test && npm run native:check && npm run native:clippy
scripts.release:build: npm run verify && npm run native:build && npm run release:package
